text:
noah: hey team, first day! laptop and peripherals arrived. running into audio issues before standup:

noah: 1) my bluetooth headset (Plantronics B525) pairs but in Zoom/Slack calls mic input is dead. system audio shows headset as output only.

noah: 2) wired USB headset in the box isn't detected by the dock's USB ports. opened ticket TKT-22045.

alex-onboarding: welcome noah! :tada: tagging IT + ops. quick q — are you on macOS or Windows? also did you try a reboot after pairing?

noah: macOS 13.4. rebooted once. Bluetooth shows device connected for audio but Input volume meter in System Settings stays flat when i speak.

maria-it: hi noah, welcome. that usually happens when the A2DP/Hands-Free profile negotiation fails and mac picks the headset as output only. can you open Audio MIDI Setup (Applications > Utilities) and paste what shows for the headset device (Output/Input listed)?

noah: Audio MIDI shows "Plantronics B525" with only "Output" device present. no input channel.

maria-it: cool — let's try a quick test: in Terminal run `system_profiler SPAudioDataType -json | grep -i plantronics -C 3` and paste output. if the device is missing as input we can try removing the Bluetooth device and re-pairing while forcing the headset into HFP mode (hold call+volume for 5s on many Plantronics).

noah: ran command — nothing for plantronics. i'll forget device and re-pair in HFP mode now.

noah: re-paired and now Input appears as "Plantronics B525 Hands-Free" but mic still shows low/garbled in Slack.

maria-it: Slack desktop sometimes prefers the CoreAudio aggregated device. Try Slack Settings > Audio & Video > input device set explicitly to the Plantronics HFP entry. Also try toggling Use hardware acceleration off and restart Slack.

noah: switched Slack input to Plantronics HFP and mic works in Slack test call. :relieved: weirdly Zoom still shows poor quality — i'll try switching Zoom input to the same device.

noah: Zoom input set to the HFP channel and audio quality is fine now too. thanks maria!

noah: about the wired USB headset from the kit — when i plug it into the dock it's not detected at all. Device Manager shows nothing (mac, so check via System Report > USB).

maria-it: could be dock USB hub cable or a bad dongle. try a different USB-C port on the laptop or swap the short cable that came with the dock. if still nothing, ops can stage a replacement kit.

linda-ops: @noah we have a spare wired headset and a USB-C cable in Locker 1 (code 2406). supply-bot, reserve headset for noah?

supply-bot: [automated] Reserved: 1 wired headset (Jabra wired combo) and 1 USB-C cable for noah in Locker 1 (code 2406). Please return if unused within 14 days.

noah: tried the other USB-C and the spare cable from the kit — wired headset still not enumerating. seems like the dock hub port might be flaky.

maria-it: ok i'll mark TKT-22045 for a dock swap. @linda-ops can we stage a replacement dock for pickup? if overnight ship needed say so.

linda-ops: can leave a replacement dock in Locker 1 now — pick up anytime. if you'd prefer shipped, we can overnight.

noah: locker pickup is perfect, i'll grab between standup and 1pm. thanks all! mic + BT fix is enough for me for now. please update ticket and i can confirm when i test the new dock.

maria-it: updated TKT-22045: resolution path — BT mic fix (re-pair into HFP + select in app), dock scheduled for swap via ops locker pickup. closing after noah confirms new dock works.

noah: picked up replacement dock and tested wired headset — USB ports enumerating and headset works. closing ticket from my side. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
